verdict.rationale: LangSmith docs and SDK show programmatic dataset creation (from curated data, traces, or synthetic generation), programmatic evaluator/experiment execution (`Execute your application on the dataset to create an experiment`), and API/SDK access to trace/experiment results, all reachable from Python/TS/Go/Java SDKs, and an official MCP server exists so an agent can invoke these operations as tools. Missing for 10: a concrete end-to-end code sample showing an agent creating a dataset, kicking off an eval, and parsing results back, plus independent hands-on confirmation of the MCP server workflow.
